headline: DECK Q2 Deep Dive: Product Pipeline and Margins in Focus Amid Shifting Channel Mix
summary: Footwear and apparel conglomerate Deckers (NYSE:DECK) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q2 CY2026, with sales up 5.7% year on year to $1.02 billion. The company’s outlook for the full year was close to analysts’ estimates with revenue guided to $5.89 billion at the midpoint. Its GAAP profit of $0.94 per share was 7.3% above analysts’ consensus estimates.

headline: Deckers Brands hits historic $1bn Q1 sales driven by HOKA, UGG
summary: Deckers Brands topped $1bn in first-quarter (Q1) revenue for the first time, as strong HOKA and UGG growth offset lower sales and the strategic phase-out of standalone Koolaburra operations.
